title: LifeLedger — AI Health Intelligence Platform
tagline: AI-Powered Personal Health Intelligence Platform & Unified Medical Vault
summary: Centralized, provider-neutral digital health vault unifying longitudinal medical records, appointments, and prescriptions with LLM-based clinical report summarization and symptom guidance.
problem: Patient health records are fractured across hospital portals (Apollo, Practo, 1mg, physical files), causing clinical context loss, manual review friction, and missed follow-up care.
solution: Architected a provider-neutral digital health ecosystem featuring JWT + RBAC across 25+ endpoints, LLM clinical document extraction, Redis caching, real-time Socket.io alerts, and a longitudinal health timeline.
highlights: Engineered centralized digital health vault unifying medical records, prescriptions, and lab vitals into an immutable longitudinal timeline.
Built multi-role access control (Patient, Doctor, Admin) enforcing JWT + RBAC permissions centrally via Express middleware.
Integrated LLM-based summarization and symptom-guidance features into the document pipeline, slashing report-review overhead.
Modeled 10+ MongoDB collections with compound indexing, enabling fast sub-50ms longitudinal queries.
Introduced Redis caching for frequently queried doctor schedules and Socket.io for immediate emergency and appointment alerts.

title: Flight Route Optimization Engine
tagline: Graph-based flight routing and distance evaluation tool analyzing transit hops, network efficiency, and shortest pathways.
summary: Algorithmic engine and interactive canvas visualizer evaluating multi-leg aviation transitions across directed, weighted graphs using Dijkstra and A* pathfinding.
problem: Evaluating multi-leg flight corridors across dense international hubs requires geodesic Great-Circle distance modeling, transfer penalties, and asymmetric flight availability.
solution: Built memory-efficient adjacency list graph structures in Python/C++, paired with a custom index-tracked binary min-heap for O(log V) priority updates, and an interactive HTML5 Canvas visualizer.
highlights: Implemented Dijkstra and A* algorithms over directed, weighted adjacency list graphs.
Custom binary min-heap priority queue reducing vertex extraction complexity to O(log V).
Incorporated Great-Circle spherical trigonometric distance and layover minimum penalties.
Rendered dynamic flight paths, transit nodes, and real-time shortest corridors on HTML5 Canvas.

title: Personal Finance Tracker
tagline: Full-stack personal finance and ledger application with dynamic cashflow analytics and budget forecasting.
summary: Full-stack Python/Flask financial analytics suite featuring normalized 3NF relational schemas, dynamic Chart.js dashboards, and secure session management.
problem: Manual spreadsheet reconciliation makes identifying discretionary cashflow leaks and sticking to category budgets tedious and prone to human error.
solution: Engineered an end-to-end platform with parameterized SQL queries, interactive spending breakdown charts, threshold alerts, and bcrypt session isolation.
highlights: Engineered normalized 3NF relational schema in MySQL with composite indexes on (user_id, transaction_date).
Eliminated SQL injection vulnerabilities through parameterized multi-criteria query builders.
Created dynamic client-side Chart.js dashboards displaying spending distribution and monthly cashflow balances.
Integrated visual budget thresholds providing real-time alerts when categories exceed planned limits.

title: Chai Code Café Management System
tagline: 3-terminal order dispatch, table billing, and inventory tracking platform engineered for high-turnover dining operations.
summary: Specialized point-of-sale and kitchen order dispatch platform built to coordinate café table turnover, live KOT queues, and automated revenue audits.
problem: Small café environments suffer from lost paper tickets, conflicting table states, and billing race conditions during peak rushes.
solution: Built a 3-terminal POS system (Floor order, Kitchen Display System, Cashier billing) with MySQL row-level locking (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) inside atomic transactions.
highlights: Engineered 3-tier operational workflow coordinating floor servers, kitchen prep displays, and cashier desks.
Guaranteed concurrency safety using MySQL SELECT FOR UPDATE transactions during simultaneous table edits.
Implemented live Kitchen Order Ticketing (KOT) with priority aging and customization notes.
Responsive, high-contrast touch interface optimized for fast table turnaround on tablets.

title: Smart E-Commerce Application
tagline: Full-stack e-commerce engine featuring JWT authentication, persistent cart state, and optimized catalog queries.
summary: Decoupled MERN stack application with signed JWT authentication in HTTP-only cookies, compound-indexed faceted search, and automated Postman test suites.
problem: Cart state synchronization inconsistencies across devices and slow unindexed database queries during multifaceted product searches.
solution: Designed decoupled RESTful endpoints with MongoDB compound indexing and custom React state hooks for predictable order lifecycles.
highlights: Architected clean separation between React SPA interface and Express/Node RESTful API backend.
Signed JWT authentication with bcrypt salted passwords and secure HTTP-only refresh token rotation.
Configured MongoDB compound indexes for instantaneous faceted category, price, and rating queries.
Automated Postman test suite validating response schemas, status codes, and authorization rules.

title: CivicTracker & CivicTech Platform
tagline: Citizen grievance reporting, status pipeline, and civic infrastructure issue tracker.
summary: Community issue management portal enabling residents to log local civic issues, track municipal resolution progress, and audit ward-level performance.
problem: Lack of transparency and tracking in municipal complaint redressal, leading to neglected public infrastructure repairs.
solution: Engineered an intuitive reporting portal with category routing, status lifecycle progression (Reported -> In Review -> Resolved), and public verification.
highlights: End-to-end TypeScript codebase ensuring strong type safety across API contracts and UI forms.
Structured grievance categorization: roads, water supply, electrical hazards, sanitation.
Real-time status tracking enabling transparent oversight of public works accountability.

title: AI Resume & ATS Intelligence Analyzer
tagline: Intelligent resume parsing, keyword scoring, and ATS compliance evaluation engine.
summary: NLP-assisted resume scoring tool analyzing candidate profiles against target job descriptions, extracting key competencies, and highlighting skills gaps.
problem: Job candidates face automated ATS rejections without feedback on missing keywords, formatting traps, or relevance metrics.
solution: Built a text extraction and semantic scoring pipeline that highlights missing technical keywords, calculates match coefficients, and offers actionable bullet point rewrites.
highlights: Automated PDF parsing and text tokenization for technical work history extraction.
TF-IDF and semantic similarity scoring benchmarked against industry job specifications.
Actionable recommendations providing concrete phrasing enhancements for quantified achievements.

title: NEXUS Initiative — Autonomous Multi-Agent Coordination
tagline: Exploring multi-agent dynamics, counterfactual simulations, and deterministic evaluation harnesses.
summary: Research-led initiative investigating autonomous agent negotiation, decision arenas, and synthetic evaluation environments under constrained resources.
problem: Evaluating emergent multi-agent behaviors under ambiguous constraints requires deterministic testing environments rather than ad-hoc prompting.
solution: Conceptualizing specialized simulation harnesses (Agent Arena, What-If Simulator) to systematically evaluate agent negotiation, task delegation, and decision boundaries.
highlights: Formulated architectural blueprint for deterministic multi-agent simulation testbed.
Designed Agent Arena framework for collaborative vs. competitive resource negotiation.
Designed What-If Counterfactual Simulator tracking branching decision trajectories.
Defined structured telemetry capture for token spend, latency, and reasoning graphs.
